_comment: MEA Pipeline Config. CLI flags always override these values. Remove _comment keys before use.

io._comment: Set output_dir for all results. checkpoint_dir defaults to <output_dir>/checkpoints if not set.

sorting._comment: sorter options: kilosort4, mountainsort5, tridesclous. docker_image only needed for containerized sorting.

burst_detection._comment: burst_detector options: parameter_free (default, adaptive fragment/network-burst/superburst hierarchy) | gaussian (mirrors the lab MATLAB pipeline's ThresholdMethod='Adaptive' as actually shipped: no height/amplitude threshold, peaks gated by prominence + min distance only; network_bursts tier only, no merging). gaussian_* fields only apply when burst_detector is 'gaussian'; gaussian_min_prominence: null derives it from the signal (baseline SD, per-unit Hz), or set an explicit Hz/unit value to mirror MATLAB's MinPeakProminence.

filtering._comment: Driver only. reference_file = Excel with 'Run #' and 'Assay' columns.

plotting._comment: plot_mode: separate | merged. raster_sort: none | firing_rate | location_y | unit_id. fixed_y: use fixed y-axis limits (run once without it first).

curation._comment: Set no_curation to true to skip unit filtering entirely.

quality_thresholds._comment: amplitude_median is negative (uV). Units with amplitude > this value are rejected.
